first.title: Psalm 30:12: name the omitted mark oleh rather than revia
first.body:
Written by a Codex session on 2026-10-15. Ben asked to “correct Psalm30:12 doc-note to say oleh instead of revia.”

At [Psalm 30:12](https://he.wikisource.org/w/index.php?oldid=2988182#%D7%9C_%D7%99%D7%91), MAM has `לִ֥֫י`; the note quotes Aleppo as `לִ֥י` but says “השמטת נקודת הרביע”. Please name the omitted mark **oleh**, rather than revia.

MAM’s [analogous policy for revia with geresh muqdam](https://he.wikisource.org/w/index.php?oldid=3087893#%D7%A8%D7%91%D7%99%D7%A2_%D7%9E%D7%95%D7%92%D7%A8%D7%A9)—supplying revia even on the same letter—may explain the slip. That explanation is a hypothesis.

second.title: Psalm 42:3: add the note about supplied oleh
second.body:
Written by a Codex session on 2026-10-15. Ben asked to “add expected Psalm42:3 note about supplied oleh on same letter as yored.”

Please add the corresponding doc-note at [Psalm 42:3](https://he.wikisource.org/wiki/%D7%AA%D7%94%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%9D_%D7%9E%D7%91/%D7%98%D7%A2%D7%9E%D7%99%D7%9D#%D7%9E%D7%91_%D7%92). MAM has `לְאֵ֢ל חָ֥֫י`; the [Introduction’s list](https://he.wikisource.org/w/index.php?oldid=3087740#%D7%A2%D7%95%D7%9C%D7%94_%D7%95%D7%99%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%93) quotes Aleppo as `לְאֵ֢ל חָ֥י`, without the oleh mark. MAM supplies oleh on the same letter as yored.

The Aleppo attribution comes from the Introduction; no manuscript image was checked. The other twelve listed cases have corresponding notes, including the Psalm 30:12 wording error addressed separately in #309.
